posts.title: The Best Day of My Life
posts.summary: A father flew his kids at first light to the Oklahoma-Texas game (Cotton Bowl, 2023); at the end of a long day his son said it was the best day of his life without knowing he was heard. The first commissioned canvas. Austin is NOT a collection - this is commissioned art.

posts.title: Angels and Demons
posts.summary: Mind, Body & Spirit - the LIGHT abstract (img-8166-2, not the blue). Two faces, angel and demon, light and dark. MBS is a collection AND commissioned art. First-pass story pending PIC meaning.
